title: Palmer interview: compositions, birth, teachers, piano greats, Margaret Johnson records
summary: The second session starts inside one block: Palmer's tunes, birth in 1901 and Georgia upbringing, Fats Waller and James P. Johnson, Longshaw, Bessie Smith's husband, and the Margaret Johnson recordings.
